  <bpmn:process id="Process_BecomingAParent" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BeginPlanning" name="Begin maternity leave planning"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch information about potential models"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectModel" name="Select a model"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifySplit" name="Notify both parties"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_NotifyCompanies" name="Notify companies"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_NotifyJoin" name="Notifications sent"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation" name="Gather information from companies"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension at the end of the period"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" name="Extend the leave?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen" name="Extension chosen"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoExtension" name="Extension not chosen"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Fetch" sourceRef="StartEvent_BeginPlanning" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fetch_Select" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="UserTask_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Collect" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_NotifySplit" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Gateway_NotifySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_SocialSecurity" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifySplit_Companies" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifySplit" targetRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SocialSecurity_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Companies_NotifyJoin" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyJoin_Gather" sourceRef="Gateway_NotifyJoin" targetRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Decide" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation" targetRef="UserTask_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decide_Gateway" sourceRef="UserTask_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionChosen" name="Extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_ExtensionChosen">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">extensionChosen</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoExtension" name="Do not extend" sourceRef="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_NoExtension"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ExtensionDecision" default="Flow_NoExtension"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_BecomingAParent">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Parent" name="Parent" processRef="Process_BecomingAParent"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_SocialSecurity" name="Social Security"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Companies" name="Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifySocialSecurity" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Participant_SocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NotifyCompanies" sourceRef="SendTask_NotifyCompanies" targetRef="Participant_Companies"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyInformation" sourceRef="Participant_Companies" targetRef="ReceiveTask_GatherCompanyInformation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
